question: In November 2022, the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the naming of Greenfield Airport at Hollongi, ltanagar as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Donyi Polo Airport.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Donyi Polo Airport, Itanagar:-**

 
 
• **It is a domestic airport serving Itanagar, the capital city of Arunachal Pradesh, India. **
 
• It is located at Hollongi, situated 14 km south from the city centre, in the Papum Pare district. 
 
• The airport is named after Donyi Polo, the supreme deity of the Tani people, the indigenous people of Arunachal Pradesh. The name "Donyi Polo" means "Sun and Moon" in the Tani language.
 
• **In November 2022, the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the naming of Greenfield Airport at Hollongi, Itanagar as Donyi Polo Airport, Itanagar. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport:-**

 
 
• **It is an international airport serving Guwahati, the largest city in North-East India in Assam, India. **
 
• It is the 12th busiest airport in India.
 
• The airport is named after Gopinath Bordoloi, a freedom fighter and the first Chief Minister of Assam after India's independence.
